author: J K rowling
title: Harry potter and the deathly hallows
description: In Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows, Harry, Ron, and Hermione leave Hogwarts to hunt and destroy Lord Voldemort's remaining Horcruxes. Along the way, they discover the fabled Deathly Hallows—three artifacts that make their possessor the "Master of Death"—and ultimately return for a climactic battle to defeat Voldemort forever.
